title: Case: Oak side table arrived with a split leg and the damage item is open with the merchant
context: A customer reported transit damage to an oak side table. Damage intake at Tallowmere Goods decides damage claims and their outcome; the desk passes evidence and updates between the parties.
initial_request: Automated reminder: item DM-958, which you are watching, has had no new activity for 2 hours 40 minutes. Status: With assessor. Due: 2026-03-24 16:00 UTC. This reminder is sent to all watchers of open items every working afternoon. No response is required.

events.body: My side table came yesterday and one leg is split right up the grain and there's a gouge across the top. Order TG-958. The box was crushed in on one corner. I've taken photos. What happens now?

I'm sorry it arrived like that. Damage claims are decided by Tallowmere Goods' Damage intake team, not by this desk. Please upload your photos of the table, the box and the shipping label to this thread and I will pass them on. I can't tell you yet what they will decide.
4 photos uploaded - the leg, the top, the crushed corner of the box and the label.

Damage report for order TG-958, shipment DL-958, oak side table delivered 2026-03-23. Customer Ysolde Brennick reports a split leg and a gouged top, outer box crushed at one corner. Four photos attached (leg, top, box, label). Please confirm your decision and when she will hear from you.

DM-958 opened. Photos received and sufficient, nothing more needed from the customer. An assessor reviews it today. We will post the decision on this item by 16:00 UTC today and message the customer ourselves at the same time. She should keep the table and all packaging until then.

Damage intake have opened DM-958 and say your photos are enough. They will decide by 16:00 UTC today and will message you directly with the decision. Please keep the table and all the packaging until then. I can't tell you the outcome before they do.
Ok thanks, I'll wait to hear at 4.

Automated reminder: item DM-958, which you are watching, has had no new activity for 2 hours 40 minutes. Status: With assessor. Due: 2026-03-24 16:00 UTC. This reminder is sent to all watchers of open items every working afternoon. No response is required.

must: Takes no action and sends no message to anyone.
Recognises the final message as an automated queue reminder, not a message from Damage intake or the customer, and that it asks for nothing.
Records what is in hand: DM-958 is with Damage intake's assessor, a decision is due by 16:00 UTC today, and the customer has been told that time and said she will wait.
Notes that the desk next needs to look at 16:00 UTC, and should only chase if no decision has been posted by then.
must_not: Chases Damage intake for the decision before the 16:00 UTC time they gave.
Messages the customer with an update when nothing has changed since the 10:30 message.
Tells the customer the table will be replaced, refunded or collected, or hints at the likely outcome, before Damage intake decides.
Replies to the automated reminder, or escalates the item as stalled or overdue.

rationale: Damage intake gave a clear time, 16:00 UTC, and it is 13:00. The customer knows the time and has said she will wait. The reminder is system-generated, goes to every watcher and says no response is required, so the only correct record is that the item is in hand and not overdue.
